csv_scope_of_work: The Social Security Administration (SSA or the agency) is seeking firms interested in providing multi-discipline Architect and Engineer (A-E) services on a nationwide scale (throughout the United States and its territories). SSA intends to negotiate a single-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity (IDIQ) contract with an A-E firm that the agency determines is the most highly qualified/most preferred in accordance with 40 U.S.C. chapter 11, Selection of Architects and Engineers, and part 36 of the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO). Firms will be evaluated on their demonstrated competence and qualifications for the required work provided in this announcement. The pre-solicitation number is 28321326R00000018.

title: Nationwide Architect & Engineer Services
short_description: Nationwide IDIQ for multidisciplinary architect and engineer services for the Social Security Administration.
project_location: Baltimore, Maryland, USA; nationwide throughout the United States and its territories
project_scope: Single-award indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for nationwide multidisciplinary A/E services for the Social Security Administration. Scope includes architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering. No specific building, bridge, span, floor area, or construction volume is defined in the notice.
services: Multidiscipline architect and engineer services under an IDIQ contract; requested disciplines include architecture services, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-like nationwide IDIQ without a defined technical project scope.
- General building and architectural services dominate; no specific bridge, long-span roof, special structure, or sports facility identified.
- Includes civil engineering, but no concrete structural engineering task, span, or complex load-bearing structure is described.
- Single-award A/E services could theoretically offer entry, but the notice is too broad and unspecific for sbp's core profile.
- Framework agreements without technical specification are explicitly low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is a nationwide IDIQ for on-call A/E services and does not define individual projects, quantities, or construction volumes, so no realistic project construction cost estimate is possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee or contract value is stated in the notice. Because this is a nationwide single-award IDIQ for undefined future task orders, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Firms will be evaluated on demonstrated competence and qualifications for the required work in accordance with 40 U.S.C. chapter 11 and FAR part 36. Requested disciplines: architecture services, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering. No specific minimum number of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Selection based on demonstrated competence and qualifications; SSA intends to negotiate with the most highly qualified/most preferred A-E firm in accordance with 40 U.S.C. chapter 11 and FAR part 36. No weighting is stated in the provided text.
